meta.name: optimal-study-protocols
meta.description: Guide users through science-based study and learning protocols derived from neuroscience research. Use when the user asks "how should I study", "help me learn this material", "study plan", "optimize my learning", "prepare for an exam", "improve retention", "memorize this", or wants a structured approach to learning new skills or information. 基于神经科学的最优学习协议：帮助用户制定科学的学习计划，提升记忆力和学习效率。

copy.tagline: 制定基于神经科学的学习计划，提升记忆效率
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果想用科学方法高效学习、备考或提升记忆力
copy.tagline_en: Create science-based study plans to boost memory and learning efficiency
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to study efficiently using neuroscience-backed methods

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会引导你使用基于神经科学的学习方法，包括专注准备、主动学习、自我测试、间隔休息和分散复习，帮你制定学习计划并提升记忆效果。
howto.when: 当你询问如何学习、制定学习计划、准备考试、提高记忆力或需要结构化学习方法时触发。

say.text: 帮我制定一个学习计划，我要准备下周的生物考试。
say.note: Claude 会给出分天的学习安排。

say.text: 我想用科学方法记住这些历史日期。
say.note: Claude 会建议自我测试和间隔重复。

say.text: 如何高效学习一门新编程语言？
say.note: Claude 会提供分阶段的学习协议。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude guides you through neuroscience-based study methods including focus preparation, active learning, self-testing, deliberate breaks, and spaced repetition to create study plans and improve memory retention.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask about how to study, create a study plan, prepare for an exam, improve memory, or need a structured learning approach.

say_en.text: Help me create a study plan for my biology exam next week.
say_en.note: Claude will provide a day-by-day schedule.

say_en.text: I want to memorize these historical dates using science.
say_en.note: Claude will suggest self-testing and spaced repetition.

say_en.text: How to efficiently learn a new programming language?
say_en.note: Claude will offer a phased study protocol.
